text:
Alex Cheng: FYI - saw a KMS unwrap that returned plaintext for workspace=org:acme when called by svc-embed-proxy (belongs to org:peach). This looks like a cross-workspace key access. Happened at 09:12 UTC. Attaching minimal logs below.

DevSecBot: incident created INC-2026-0894, priority P1, paging oncall.

Samira Patel: ugh. Any recent RBAC changes? Last week we merged the role alias refactor PR right?

Alex Cheng: yes merged 1839120 - role-aliases. Suspect mapping from project->org role collapsed workspace scoping. Example log:

```
2026-03-18T09:12:21Z svc=svc-embed-proxy user=svc-embed-proxy@peach workspace=peach-project-7 key=kms://acme/emb-key action=Decrypt result=OK principal=serviceAccount:peach:svc-embed-proxy
```

Kai Morgan: can you repro locally with a synthetic project? If this is KMS unwrap, maybe policy filters aren't being applied in the KMS proxy.

Isabel Ortiz: ping @Tony Ramirez — Tony, did the KMS proxy change last deploy? I recall you touched key-scoping checks.

Tony Ramirez: pushed a patch to KMS proxy last night (optimize key lookup). Nothing obvious but will roll logs. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4672

Samira Patel: short mitigation - revoke svc-embed-proxy's KMS unwrap permission cluster-wide and run canary tests. Can we do that without customer impact?

Alex Cheng: quick mitigation done: removed `kms.keyUnwrap` from svc-embed-proxy in prod (temp). Monitoring shows no other unwraps. Impact: embeddings generation fails for some internal tests, user-facing paths still routed to fallback model.

DevSecBot: timeline updated. Owner: Alex Cheng. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kms-cross-access

Kai Morgan: reproduction steps I'm running now:
1) create two workspaces A and B
2) create key in A, grant access to A's service account only
3) call unwrap using B's service account via embed-proxy

I'll post logs.

Isabel Ortiz: if RA mapping is the root cause we need a patch reversing alias collapse and add unit tests for workspace boundary enforcement in role mapper.

Tony Ramirez: rolling a hotfix patch 4675 to re-add explicit workspace scoping within the lookup. Deploying to staging now.

Samira Patel: check audit logs: we need to prove no customer data leaked. Alex, can you export decrypt events for the affected key (kms://acme/emb-key) for last 24h and share hash of plaintexts if available?

Alex Cheng: exporting, will post hashes and counts to secure channel.

DevSecBot: compliance note: notified Legal and Customer Trust. Suggested safe disclosure timeline.

Kai Morgan: repro successful in staging. Confirmed unwrap with wrong principal when role aliases map to org:role without workspace qualifier. Patch 4675 prevents alias flattening and adds integration test.

Alex Cheng: thanks. next steps: coordinate rollback/patch cut, run customer impact sweep, update changelog and postmortem template. I'll create follow-up thread for postmortem.

Samira Patel: :thumbsup: keep us posted, good catch everyone.
